citations.assessment: The Mishnah gives their drawn-water testimony in the name of Shemayah and Avtalyon, distinguishes Shammai’s and Hillel’s figures, and explicitly numbers the weavers as two.
Rashi explains the mention of occupation and place as an encouragement to pursue study despite status.
The comparator lists trades not selected for kingship or the high priesthood and describes the reason in terms of the trades’ standing. Heilprin applies it to his separate weavers account.
